_note: Tooltip and completion docs for language keywords. Keys must exist in data/keywords.json (control / declarations / types / misc); a misspelled key will never show up. sig = signature, d = one-line description.

main.d: Script entry point; the game starts running the script here.

defineVariable.d: Defines a global variable. The type can be a built-in type or a struct.

defineStruct.d: Defines a struct type; add fields with defineStructVariable and methods with defineStructInstruction.

defineStructVariable.d: Adds a field to a struct.

defineStructArray.d: Adds an array field to a struct.

defineStructInstruction.d: Adds a method to a struct.

if.d: Conditional branch. In a condition, ? means equal, ! means not, and & and | are logical operators that do not short-circuit.

elseif.d: Only elseif exists, not else if. You can chain several.

else.d: Used together with if, meaning otherwise.

for.d: Comma-separated: for (i=0, i<n, i=i+1). Semicolons cannot be used.

while.d: Repeats while the condition is true.

return.d: Ends the current function and returns the value of the expression.

returnVoid.d: Ends a function whose return type is void.
